items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I read in one place Barry White they were giving out quotes some news report saying 13 members of the were coming and I know that must be wrong. [INTERVIEWEE] Fourteen.

ctx.x:
Not the first time -- I don't know -- I can't remember. We may have played a couple of numbers for the last night. Yeah, they usually -- everybody does something. The entertainers do something that last night you know before you dock.

I think we did play.

Were there additional members of the band by that time? I read in one place Barry White they were giving out quotes some news report saying 13 members of the were coming and I know that must be wrong.
